svg.aria-label: Two pipelines side by side. A knowledge ontology, built for inference, runs classes, properties, individuals and axioms (OWL 2 / RDF) through a reasoner and produces entailments: the computed hierarchy, classifications and consistency, derived at runtime and not in the diff — a second source of truth. An executable business ontology, built to run, takes typed metadata (objects and fields, relations, actions, permissions, flows, agent and tool definitions) through validation (strict TypeScript and Zod, os validate: a located error or nothing) and then runs it into the database, the REST and realtime API, the UI and the MCP server; nothing is reasoned over at runtime, what runs is what was validated. Beneath them, the three refusals: no inheritance, every object's file is the whole answer; no axioms, constraints reject and do not derive; no reasoner, no fact exists that nobody wrote.
svg.text: The first derives what nobody wrote. The second refuses what would not run — and derives nothing.

g.text: KNOWLEDGE ONTOLOGY — BUILT FOR INFERENCE
Classes · properties · individuals · axioms
OWL 2 / RDF: subclass, disjointness, cardinality, property chains
Reasoner
an inference engine reads the whole model and derives what follows

the computed hierarchy · classifications · consistency
derived at runtime — not in the diff
A second source of truth a reviewer cannot read
EXECUTABLE BUSINESS ONTOLOGY — BUILT TO RUN
Typed metadata
objects and fields · relations · actions · permissions · flows
agent and tool definitions
Validate
strict TypeScript + Zod · os validate — a located error, or nothing
Run
database · REST / realtime API · UI · MCP server
nothing is reasoned over at runtime
What runs is what was validated
No inheritance
every object's file is the whole answer
No axioms
constraints reject; they do not derive
No reasoner
no fact exists that nobody wrote
